title: Deep Sea Gradient
prompt:
Recreate the "Deep Sea" gradient from 21st.dev (https://21st.dev/community/gradients).

Style: Axis Blend. a straight linear gradient along `angle`, colours placed at their `pos`.
Palette: #000428 (Space) @ 0%, #004E92 (Ocean) @ 100%

Ready-to-use CSS (apply to any full-bleed element):
```css
.gradient {
  /* CSS approximation: the oversized-layer soften blur require canvas. Export an image for the exact result. */
  background-color: #000428;
  background-image: linear-gradient(160deg, #000428 0%, #004E92 100%);
}
```
